I'm thinking of starting one, and though I plan to go mostly on my gut, (so manly) I thought I'd ask what people like to see!
What would you like to see in a Vlog?

It needs to be comfortable. I don't want to feel awkward watching a vlog. You don't need to be doing something incredible every time you record, but if your activities are more boring than my life, I won't be able to be as interested.

Above all, have fun. Make it look like you're comfortable and enjoying yourself. If you're enjoying yourself, others will be able to too.

I don't. But if you want to make a video, pick a topic and follow a framework so it moves along at a decent clip, introduces something interesting along the way, and wraps up clean without rambling on.

probably most important - jump right in. you have less than 5 seconds to get to the point or click...

Have a script and rehearse before recording. Rambling all your thoughts on tape and piecing it together with jump cuts is unbearable.

Engage your audience, ask questions which make watchers think. I don't mean the typical "rate comment and subscribe!" bullshit, but maybe some rhetorical questions and such.

Also most importantly, invest in a decent microphone. Shitty video is easier to overcome than poor audio.

I'm not saying to neglect the video aspects, obviously good lighting makes a ton of difference. Maybe read up on three point lighting and other technical aspects on video/audio recording.

As for content, I have no idea, if I had an idea I was passionate about I'd probably start my own vlog.

No rambling beginning intro with shit I do not care about. I find this mostly with make up girls who just go on about why they're uploading or what they did that day. I don't give a fuck. Get into the details with a brief intro.

No "umming" and "ahhing". Edit out your breaks (I'm convinced that this is why jump cuts exist).

Don't make it about nothing, even if it is just about your life. Life can be interesting to watch. Make it that way.

I like to see extremely in-depth subject matter expertise. I don't want to watch a general interest vlog. There are so many out there that I would never pick just one general interest vlog that covered a wide range of topics or ideas. However, if you have a specialized field, esoteric knowledge, or unique skill that you explore deeply, passionately, and understand better than anyone else- that is the vlog I'd want to watch.

For the love of FSM invest on some decent audio recording equipment and learn a minimum about audio manipulation/production. It makes a massive difference when you don't sound like you're in a tin can or that the mic is in your butt.
Yeah if you could just use a decent mic, that would be great.

What kind videos will you be making? I like to watch a lot of j-vloggers and booktubers - people living in Japan who make videos about it, and people who make videos talking about books. One thing I would say is important is to keep the video at around three minutes long and to have good audio.
